stories.title: Ian Buck Kicks Off NVIDIA’s Week at SC26 as Science Enters the Age of Agents
stories.description: NVIDIA’s Ian Buck kicked off the company’s week at SC26 in Chicago on Monday with new tools for AI agents, software that can plan experiments, run code and check results on researchers’ own systems. In NVIDIA’s special address, Buck announced Nemotron for Science, the Rubin HPC GPU and an expanded Vera CPU platform for high-performance […]
